['Select molecule_chembl_id, molecule_name, max_phase, molecule_type, canonical_smiles', 'From molecule_dictionary', 'Left Join compound_records On molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_records.molregno', 'Left Join docs On compound_records.doc_id = docs.doc_id', "Filter docs.chembl_id = 'CHEMBL1125208'", 'Left Join compound_structures On molecule_dictionary.molregno = compound_structures.molregno', 'Return molecule_chembl_id, molecule_name, max_phase, molecule_type, canonical_smiles', 'Sort by molecule_chembl_id', 'Limit 0']
